evidence.native_oracle: JDK 17 javac compilation of locked standalone fixtures
evidence.closure: family-local copied skills with no Maven, Gradle, JAR, network, or repository-runtime dependency
evidence.promotion: deferred until fresh product-framed review and closeout replay

transferred: Inventory first-party Java source and classify tests, generated source, fixtures, vendor/dependencies, build output, and symlinks before analysis.
Use JDK source-file launch for a self-contained copied helper when syntax facts are necessary.
Verify each skill at its final human-readable and structured artifact, not at parser output.
Keep complete, partial, unsupported, and failed outcomes honest without forcing one failure policy across skills.
did_not_transfer: One universal Java AST or fact schema.
TypeScript Compiler API loaders or Go parser helpers.
Inheritance, annotation processor or Lombok output, framework behavior, runtime dispatch, or Kotlin support.
Automatic refactor safety from public declarations, exact body fingerprints, or direct-call syntax facts.
language_specific: Java Unicode escapes may create comment delimiters before tokenization; decision-comment auditing validates through the JDK before lexical extraction.
Interface members may be implicitly public.
JDK-tree body fingerprints are exact clone evidence only.
Source-root conventions are project evidence, not a framework inference.

reuse_decision.candidate: generated and tested Java source-policy/preflight template
reuse_decision.promotion_trigger: adopt only when measured reuse reduces total maintained code and preserves each on-demand skill's explicit copied closure

next_cohort_guidance: Use compiler attribution only where a claimed identity or relationship requires it.
Make detector consumers reuse accepted producer artifacts instead of re-detecting.
Keep mutations serial and proposals read-only until explicit human approval.
Run one fresh product review across the integrated Java user journeys before matrix promotion.
